key_messages: I am running because working families deserve a government that protects them instead of protecting corporations and political donors.
I believe in reproductive freedom, well-funded public schools, safe communities, and a humane border system that values both security and human dignity.
I am committed to progressive values that meet people where they are.
Chelsey Hockett.passions: I am passionate about building a country where every person has dignity, safety, and the freedom to live a full life.

points: Working people deserve power, safety, and a fair share of the wealth they create.
As your representative, I will fight to strengthen unions, raise wages, enforce labor and safety laws, break up corporate monopolies, and hold the ultra-wealthy accountable.

As your representative, I will fight for housing as a human right, immigration policies rooted in humanity instead of detention and fear, full reproductive autonomy, and the safety and rights of LGBTQ+ people.
Every person deserves dignity, safety, and freedom, here and abroad.
I oppose U.S. funding for Israel’s genocide in Gaza, and I support a free Palestine.
Healthcare should be based on need, not income or employment.
As your representative, I will fight for Medicare for All, protect reproductive freedom, expand maternal and mental health care, strengthen rural hospitals, and end medical debt.
Our lives do not have to be this difficult. Many other countries have found ways to support government-sponsored healthcare. It is time that we catch up!

issues.issue: Climate, Infrastructure, & the Green New Deal
points: We can fight climate change while creating good union jobs and rebuilding our communities.
As your representative, I will fight for a Green New Deal framework that invests in clean energy, strong infrastructure, and good union jobs while protecting our land and water from exploitation.
Strong public schools are the foundation of a healthy democracy and a strong economy.
As your representative, I will fight to fully fund public education, support and respect educators, and make sure resources go where they belong, into classrooms and student support services.
Education is a human right. Education is freedom.
Democracy only works when people can participate freely and trust that the system is fair.
As your representative, I will fight to protect and expand voting rights, ensure fair and accessible elections, and end partisan efforts to silence voters.
I support overturning Citizens United, strong ethics laws, transparent government, and real limits on money in politics so corporations and billionaires cannot buy influence.

Secure the Border. Fix Immigration with Common Sense. Bobby believes South Texas doesn’t need border politics, it needs border solutions.
Make Life Affordable. Build a Strong South Texas Economy. Bobby’s focus is making life affordable and building an economy that works for working people.
Bobby Pulido.passions: Bobby is personally passionate about healthcare because in South Texas it isn’t theoretical, it’s personal.

points: In the Valley and across South Texas, the economy we care about is not a bunch of numbers and letters flashing on a board on Wall Street.
People down here don’t expect handouts, but they do expect and deserve a fair shot.
I will also focus on cutting the red tape that strangles small businesses because down here the heart of our economy is driven by small local businesses, working families and entrepreneurs.

America’s strength starts with the land and the people who work it. Our farmers and ranchers don’t want handouts, but they do need fair markets, fair and open trade, and the freedom to do what they do best.
Tariffs and trade wars are driving up costs and closing off opportunities, leaving too many of our families struggling to keep up.
I believe in strong, commonsense agricultural policy that protects our natural resources, supports rural families, and keeps safe, affordable, American-grown food on every table.

Our goal as a country should be to have a secure border – a policy that should not change based on what president or party is in charge – and we have to go after the violent criminals that are here illegally and get…

The problem is that when it comes to the immigration debate, for a long time now, it’s been happening among a bunch of politicians in Washington who don’t want to solve the problem and don’t care about what people like…

I believe we can secure the border without destroying families and our local economy in the process. We can more effectively attack the flow of fentanyl and other cartel driven drug supply lines into our country.
The truth is that today, healthcare costs are crushing families and in rural areas all across the country hospitals are in danger of having to close their doors.
For starters, I believe that, like Social Security, Medicare is a promise and a critical safety net that we have to keep and make stronger.
Here’s another truth – our current representative took orders from her party leaders and voted for a so-called “big beautiful bill” that put Medicaid and South Texas seniors at risk.

issues.issue: Education That Invests in Our Kids and Teachers
points: I believe strong public schools are critical to the success of South Texas. That’s why I oppose voucher schemes that drain money from our classrooms and send it to private schools.
Parents should know their kids are getting a fair shot at success no matter their zip code and that starts with doing right by our teachers and the school system that supports them.

That’s why I will focus on making sure teachers get paid better for educating our sons and daughters, on reducing classroom overcrowding, and investing in skills training so every student is prepared to do the jobs of…

issues.issue: Water Is Life; and It’s Running Out
points: The Valley has been dealing with a growing water crisis. Without action, there’s no farming, no jobs, no future.

I’ll fight to hold Mexico accountable for water treaty obligations and build a regional strategy that prioritizes South Texas families and farmers. If we can’t secure our water, we can’t secure the Valley’s future.

Protect the separation of powers by making sure Congress can fully check the actions of the executive branch.
Defend the rule of law by supporting a strong and independent judicial branch that can review executive decisions.
There was a time in this country when working 40 hours a week meant you could buy a home, raise a family, and retire with dignity.

Raise the federal minimum wage to $15 an hour

issues.issue: Guaranteeing Access to Healthcare Through Medicare for All
points: Healthcare is not a privilege – it’s a basic human right. No one should be denied care because of their income or insurance status.
In Congress, he will fight to guarantee access to care by expanding Medicare, strengthening Medicaid, and ensuring coverage includes dental, vision, and hearing.
Every child deserves a great public education—but politicians are starving our schools of funding and turning classrooms into battlegrounds.
In Congress, he’ll fight to fully fund public education, raise teacher pay, and expand Pell Grants so every student can afford college or career training.
Texas politicians have stripped away women’s rights, making it harder to access reproductive healthcare.
Every American deserves a voice in our democracy, but Republican leaders are working to silence voters and rig the system for themselves.
In Congress, he’ll fight to pass the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act and the Freedom to Vote Act to protect every voter.
Too many communities in TX-18 are marked by vacant lots, crumbling infrastructure, and a lack of basic necessities like grocery stores.
No one should worry that the air they breathe, the water they drink, or the land around them is making them sick.
Everyone deserves to live with dignity and be treated equally under the law—no matter who they are or who they love.
Tom Sell stands for America-First policies that protect our values, strengthen our economy, and secure our future. Learn about the key issues driving his campaign for Congress.

issues.issue: Economy of the People and for the People
points: Every day life is too expensive for the average American, and Congress needs to act
The cost of living continues to skyrocket while corporations rake in record profits. As your congressman, I will enact fair pricing legislation to bring down the cost of living.
Housing has become unaffordable to young people, and corporations continue to buy single-family homes in order to force us all to rent from them.
Immigrants are an important part of our communities, the legal pathways to become American citizens should be expanded

The legal immigration process in the U.S. is far too complex, and this complexity encourages illegal immigration. We must streamline the immigration process to enable immigrants to enter the United States legally.
America has always been a safe haven for the persecuted; we should not turn our backs on those who need our help.

issues.issue: Protecting American Livelihood and Personal Data
points: In the digital age, everyday citizens' private data is vulnerable; we must take steps to protect our citizens
Digital innovation is important for our economy, but it should not come at the expense of American citizens' private information.
As your congressman, I will enact legislation that stiffens penalties for companies who mishandle your private information and increase safeguards to ensure your data is not stolen.
Congress needs to prioritize the revitalization of farms and rural communities across West Texas
For too long, both parties have neglected rural communities. As your next Congressman, I will be a tireless advocate for rural communities and family farms.
When I am elected, I will introduce legislation to freeze interest rates on loans for small, family-owned farms.

issues.issue: Defend Medicaid, Medicare, Social Security, and Veterans Affairs
points: For generations, Americans have paid into Medicaid, Medicare, and Social Security. I will fight tirelessly to protect the programs you deserve
Medicaid, Medicare, Social Security, and Veterans Affairs are essential to supporting working families and veterans who rely on these programs to live long, happy, economically free lives.
Inspired by Lyndon B. Johnson and the Great Society, I will be a constant defender of the working class and veterans and the programs which were created to support them.

issues.issue: Attack Monopolies to Protect American Industry
points: Large corporations have been allowed to monopolize our economy for too long, threatening our farmers and working class's ability to pursue the American dream.
Inspired by Theodore Roosevelt, we must break up the monopolies that have come to dominate our economy and strangle out the competition of family-run businesses.
As your next Congressman, I will empower the Small Business Administration to actively support small businesses and allow family businesses to thrive again in America.
I swore an oath to defend the Constitution of the United States. I will not stand idly by as unelected billionaires and the far right attack our country's most important document.
The Constitution has been our country's guiding light for 250 years. I will defend the principles enshrined in this document from attacks from both sides of the aisle.
Congress must protect both the Bill of Rights and the Constitution and reassert Congressional authority.
The American healthcare system is broken, Congress wont act to fix it. I will.
Americans spend more per person on our healthcare than any other country, yet we have the lowest healthcare outcomes per dollar spent than any other country.
In the smartest, most innovative country in the world there is no excuse to have the highest maternal mortality rate amongst high income countries.

Reflecting on those difficult times, I realize how many other families must face similar challenges.

Families across South Texas are feeling the pressure of rising everyday costs.
Vicente Gonzalez believes that people who work hard should be able to afford a stable and dignified life.
The impact of rising costs goes beyond household budgets. It affects education, healthcare decisions, and long-term financial planning for families throughout the district.
Seniors across South Texas deserve security, stability, and peace of mind after a lifetime of hard work.
Vicente Gonzalez understands that protecting seniors means safeguarding programs that provide financial security and access to healthcare.
Beyond financial security, seniors also face challenges related to healthcare access, prescription affordability, and long-term care support.

Women across South Texas play a vital role in families, workplaces, and communities. Protecting women’s rights means ensuring equal opportunity, economic security, and access to essential healthcare services.
Vicente Gonzalez supports policies that promote fairness, protect individual freedoms, and strengthen protections that allow women to make informed decisions about their lives and futures.
Women’s economic security is also closely tied to workplace protections, fair wages, and access to quality education and career pathways.

Education plays a critical role in shaping the future of South Texas. Strong schools provide children and young people with the tools they need to succeed and contribute meaningfully to their communities.
Vicente Gonzalez believes every student deserves access to a quality education, regardless of background or zip code. Investing in education means investing in opportunity.
Supporting educators, improving resources, and creating pathways for student success are essential parts of building a stronger education system.
Veterans have made tremendous sacrifices in service to our country. Honoring that service requires more than words — it requires meaningful support and long-term commitment.
Vicente Gonzalez is dedicated to ensuring veterans and their families have access to the benefits, healthcare, and resources they deserve.
Many veterans face challenges related to healthcare, employment, and housing. Addressing these issues is a responsibility that should be met with seriousness and respect.

Access to affordable, quality healthcare is essential for individuals and families to thrive. In South Texas, many communities still face challenges when it comes to availability, affordability, and reliable care.

Vicente Gonzalez supports a healthcare system that works for everyone — whether someone lives in an urban center or a rural community. No family should have to choose between getting medical care and meeting basic needs.

Healthcare is not only about treatment, but also prevention, mental health services, and long-term care. Strong healthcare systems provide peace of mind and protect families from unexpected financial hardship.

Strong job growth and economic opportunity are essential for the long-term prosperity of South Texas. Families and local businesses depend on a stable economy that creates pathways for success and upward mobility.
Vicente Gonzalez supports efforts that encourage job creation, strengthen small businesses, and invest in industries that bring sustainable growth to the region.

Economic opportunity means more than employment — it means access to training, skills development, and career advancement that allow individuals to build secure futures for themselves and their families.
